evi.mindestlohn.titel: The minimum wage for the new year
evi.mindestlohn.text1: At the end of the year the minimum wage commission decides what applies from January. The unions demand compensation for rising prices (inflation {inflation} %), the employers warn of costs that small businesses cannot bear.
evi.mindestlohn.warum: The minimum wage is the most important price on the labour market: it protects the poorest and supports demand, but it costs businesses room to manoeuvre and can drive up prices.
evi.mindestlohn.opt.kraeftig.label: Raise it substantially
evi.mindestlohn.opt.kraeftig.folge: workers gain, small businesses and prices come under pressure.
evi.mindestlohn.opt.mass.label: Offset the price rise
evi.mindestlohn.opt.mass.folge: a compromise that leaves both sides unhappy.
evi.mindestlohn.opt.einfrieren.label: Freeze it
evi.mindestlohn.opt.einfrieren.folge: businesses breathe a sigh of relief, the willingness to strike rises.
evi.mindestlohn.opt.einfrieren.ausgang: The minimum wage stays as it is.
evi.mindestlohn.standard: Without a decision the minimum wage stays frozen; the unions are angry.
evi.haushaltsjahr.text1: {wer} presents the draft budget for next year. Debt stands at {schulden} % of GDP, inflation at {inflation} %.
evi.haushaltsjahr.text2: For four weeks you can set the budget sliders free of charge; after that the draft goes to parliament as the budget law. If nothing is tabled, last year's budget carries on — the items rise with inflation automatically.
evi.haushaltsjahr.warum: The budget is the biggest parliamentary act of the year: once every October all sliders are decided together. Outside the window every change costs double as a supplementary budget, plus some legitimacy.
evi.haushaltsjahr.opt.entwurf.label: Prepare the draft yourself
evi.haushaltsjahr.opt.entwurf.folge: the sliders in the budget file are now free; the law needs a majority.
evi.haushaltsjahr.opt.entwurf.ausgang: The window is open: set the sliders in the budget file — packages from the finance ministry can be adopted — and table the budget law.
evi.haushaltsjahr.opt.fortschreiben.folg: no change, no risk in parliament.
evi.haushaltsjahr.opt.fortschreiben.ausg: The budget continues unchanged (adjusted for inflation).
evi.haushaltsjahr.standard: Without a decision last year's budget continues (adjusted for inflation).
evi.bergwerksunglueck.text1: A serious accident has occurred at the {firma} mine in {orte, list}; rescue teams are searching for trapped miners. Unions speak of warnings that were ignored for years.
evi.bergwerksunglueck.warum: Workplace safety usually only becomes an issue after a disaster. Oversight costs money and time; its absence costs lives and, sooner or later, trust.
evi.bergwerksunglueck.opt.untersuchen.fo: mining becomes more expensive, trust grows.
evi.bergwerksunglueck.opt.untersuchen.au: An independent commission investigates the disaster; oversight is tightened.
Compensate the families and provide emergency aid
eases the hardship, changes nothing about the causes.
evi.bergwerksunglueck.opt.betreiber.labe: Put the blame on the operator
evi.bergwerksunglueck.opt.betreiber.folg: quickly done, but the unions do not believe it.
evi.bergwerksunglueck.opt.betreiber.ausg: The operator is held to account; the criticism of oversight remains.
evi.bergwerksunglueck.standard: Without a response the anger of the miners and their families grows.
evi.ueberschwemmung.text1: Flash floods sweep away bridges and roads in {orte, list}; villages are cut off, fields are under water.
evi.ueberschwemmung.warum: Steep valleys, building along streams and missing flood defences turn heavy rain into a disaster.
evi.ueberschwemmung.opt.hilfe.label: Disaster relief and rebuilding the roads
evi.ueberschwemmung.opt.hilfe.folge: the region gets back on its feet faster.
evi.ueberschwemmung.opt.hilfe.ausgang: Rebuilding of the roads begins; those affected receive aid.
evi.ueberschwemmung.opt.schutz.label: Flood defences and relocation from danger zones
evi.ueberschwemmung.opt.schutz.folge: safer in the long run, expensive in the short run and unpopular with those who have to move.
evi.ueberschwemmung.opt.schutz.ausgang: A flood defence programme is launched; endangered settlements are relocated.
evi.ueberschwemmung.opt.kommunen.label: Leave the clean-up to the municipalities
evi.ueberschwemmung.opt.kommunen.ausgang: The municipalities clean up as best they can.
evi.ueberschwemmung.standard: Help comes late; the people in the valleys feel left in the lurch.
evi.bankenstress.text1: {bank}, a mid-sized bank, can no longer secure its refinancing; customers are withdrawing money. The risk premium stands at {aufschlag} basis points, and the markets are watching every reaction.
evi.bankenstress.warum: Banks live on trust. If the state steps in, it protects savings and rewards risky business; if it lets the bank fall, it risks a domino effect.
evi.bankenstress.opt.liquiditaet.label: Provide liquidity
evi.bankenstress.opt.liquiditaet.folge: the bank holds, lending recovers, the taxpayer is liable.
evi.bankenstress.opt.liquiditaet.ausgang: The state provides the bank with liquidity.
evi.bankenstress.opt.abwickeln.label: Wind it up and let the regulator step in
evi.bankenstress.opt.abwickeln.folge: the market learns, customers are protected, small firms suffer.
evi.bankenstress.opt.abwickeln.ausgang: The bank is wound up; deposits are protected.
evi.bankenstress.standard: Without a decision the turmoil spreads to other banks; the risk premium rises.
evi.studentenproteste.text1: In {orte, list} students occupy lecture halls and march through the city centres: against tuition fees, the housing shortage and a lack of job prospects.
evi.studentenproteste.warum: Young people without prospects are the most reliable trigger of mass protests; how a state deals with them shapes its image with everyone else.
evi.studentenproteste.opt.dialog.label: Dialogue and scholarships
evi.studentenproteste.opt.dialog.ausgang: The President receives student representatives; scholarships are increased.
evi.studentenproteste.opt.raeumen.label: Have the universities cleared
evi.studentenproteste.opt.raeumen.folge: calm on the streets; the price is the trust of the young and of foreign partners.
evi.studentenproteste.opt.raeumen.ausgan: The police clear the occupied lecture halls.
evi.studentenproteste.standard: The protests drag on and grow louder.
evi.pressekonflikt.text1: At the newspaper {blatt}, editor-in-chief {chef} and several reporters have been arrested after critical reports. Press associations and the EU demand their release; pro-government media speak of propaganda against the state.
evi.pressekonflikt.warum: Control over the media buys brief calm, but costs credibility at home and standing abroad; a state that locks up its critics gets worse information in return.
evi.pressekonflikt.opt.freilassen.label: Order their release and review the cases
evi.pressekonflikt.opt.freilassen.folge: press freedom and foreign partners are grateful, the security forces grumble.
evi.pressekonflikt.opt.freilassen.ausgan: The journalists are released; the cases are reviewed, and the newsrooms regain their nerve.
evi.pressekonflikt.opt.freilassen.grund: The interior minister feels her security forces have been let down.
evi.pressekonflikt.opt.justiz.label: Let justice take its course
evi.pressekonflikt.opt.justiz.folge: no intervention, but no signal either.
evi.pressekonflikt.opt.haerte.label: Show toughness and extend media oversight
evi.pressekonflikt.opt.haerte.folge: your camp cheers, the country and the world turn away.
evi.pressekonflikt.opt.haerte.ausgang: Media oversight is extended: fines and proceedings hit the critical papers above all, and the newsrooms leave more out.
evi.pressekonflikt.standard: The proceedings continue; the criticism persists.
evi.bauamnestie_forderung.text1: {wer} is pushing for a construction amnesty law: anyone who built without a permit pays a fee and is legalised. It brings money and votes, and it legalises houses no structural engineer has ever seen.
evi.bauamnestie_forderung.warum: Construction amnesties are popular and lucrative. They are also the reason so many houses collapse in earthquakes: anyone who knows illegal buildings will be legalised builds without inspection.
revenue and approval now, earthquake risk later.
evi.bauamnestie_forderung.opt.statik.fol: a compromise that protects building policy and only half satisfies the partner.
evi.bauamnestie_forderung.opt.statik.aus: An amnesty applies only to buildings that pass a structural inspection.
evi.bauamnestie_forderung.opt.ablehnen.f: building safety wins, the partner is annoyed.
evi.bauamnestie_forderung.opt.ablehnen.g: The partner holds the rejected construction amnesty against you.
evi.bauamnestie_forderung.standard: The demand goes unanswered; the partner grows impatient.
evi.rentnerprotest.text1: Pensioners' associations demonstrate in front of parliament: with inflation at {inflation} %, the minimum pension no longer lasts until the end of the month.
evi.rentnerprotest.warum: Pensions lag behind rising prices because they are only adjusted in steps. Pensioners vote reliably, and their hardship is visible.
evi.rentnerprotest.opt.erhoehen.label: Raise the minimum pension substantially
evi.rentnerprotest.opt.erhoehen.folge: hardship falls, the budget feels it permanently.
evi.rentnerprotest.opt.einmal.label: Make a one-off payment
evi.rentnerprotest.opt.einmal.folge: brief relief without a permanent burden on the budget.
evi.rentnerprotest.opt.ablehnen.label: Do nothing
evi.rentnerprotest.opt.ablehnen.folge: the budget stays calm, the pensioners are furious.
evi.grippewelle.text1: A flu wave paralyses schools, businesses and emergency rooms. Hospitals lack beds and staff.
evi.grippewelle.warum: How good a health system is shows at peak load, not on average.
evi.grippewelle.opt.impfen.label: Vaccination campaign and public appeals
evi.grippewelle.opt.impfen.folge: takes weeks to work, helps the most vulnerable above all.
evi.grippewelle.opt.impfen.ausgang: A nationwide vaccination campaign gets under way.
evi.grippewelle.opt.kapazitaet.label: Expand hospital capacity and staff
evi.grippewelle.opt.kapazitaet.folge: strengthens the system beyond the wave too.
evi.grippewelle.opt.kapazitaet.ausgang: Additional beds and staff are provided.
evi.grippewelle.opt.abwarten.label: Let it run its course
evi.grippewelle.opt.abwarten.ausgang: The government relies on personal responsibility.
evi.grippewelle.standard: The hospitals are overflowing; criticism of the government grows.
evi.bauernproteste.text1: Farmers block the roads with their tractors in {orte, list}: fertiliser and diesel are expensive, producer prices are falling.
evi.bauernproteste.warum: Farmers carry the risk of weather and prices. When costs rise faster than the prices they get, they give up and move to the cities.
evi.bauernproteste.opt.mindestpreise.fol: secures incomes, makes food more expensive.
evi.bauernproteste.opt.mindestpreise.aus: The state guarantees minimum prices for grain.
evi.bauernproteste.opt.gespraech.label: Talks with the associations
evi.bauernproteste.opt.gespraech.ausgang: The government invites the farmers' associations to talks.
evi.bauernproteste.standard: The blockades continue until the harvest presses.
evi.fabrikschliessungen.text1: {firma} and its suppliers are closing plants in {orte, list}: energy, wages and credit are too expensive, orders are moving to countries with lower costs.
evi.fabrikschliessungen.warum: Industry responds to costs, not speeches. When costs rise faster than the prices that can be achieved on the world market, jobs disappear that will not come back.
evi.fabrikschliessungen.opt.kurzarbeit.a: A short-time work allowance bridges the gap in orders.
evi.fabrikschliessungen.opt.kredit.label: Loan guarantees for the businesses
evi.fabrikschliessungen.opt.kredit.folge: helps the businesses, not necessarily the workers.
evi.fabrikschliessungen.opt.kredit.ausga: The state guarantees loans for the businesses affected.
evi.fabrikschliessungen.opt.umschulen.au: A retraining programme and investment incentives are launched.
evi.fabrikschliessungen.standard: The layoffs continue; the towns lack alternatives.
evi.buergermeister_verfahren.titel: Proceedings against the city hall of {orte, list}
evi.buergermeister_verfahren.text1: Prosecutors accuse the city hall of {orte, list} under {name} ({partei}) of irregularities in public contracts. The party speaks of politically motivated proceedings; the interior ministry is considering appointing a trustee.
evi.buergermeister_verfahren.warum: Where the government cannot win a city, it still has the courts. Whoever uses them gains control and loses credibility with everyone who thinks the charge is political.
preserves the appearance of the rule of law, costs control over the city.
The proceedings continue without government interference.
evi.buergermeister_verfahren.opt.verwalt: control over the city, conflict across the country.
A trustee takes over the running of the city.
Seek talks with the city leadership
eases the situation without dispelling the charge.
The President invites the city leadership to talks.
evi.buergermeister_verfahren.standard: The situation in the city remains tense; the proceedings drag on.
evi.tourismusrekord.text1: The hotels on the coast are full, the airports report record numbers. The industry asks what the state will do with the tailwind.
evi.tourismusrekord.warum: Good years are the time to build infrastructure, not just to celebrate: today's season decides the one after next.
evi.tourismusrekord.opt.ausbauen.label: Invest in coastal infrastructure
evi.tourismusrekord.opt.ausbauen.folge: secures the future of the season.
evi.tourismusrekord.opt.abgabe.label: Levy a tax on overnight stays
evi.tourismusrekord.opt.abgabe.folge: brings in money, dampens demand a little.
evi.tourismusrekord.opt.abgabe.ausgang: Overnight stays are subject to a levy.
evi.tourismusrekord.opt.geniessen.label: Enjoy the success
evi.tourismusrekord.opt.geniessen.folge: a good summer and nothing more.
evi.tourismusrekord.standard: The season ends without the state making anything of it.
evi.kanal_istanbul.text1: A megaproject is ready to go: a second waterway alongside the Bosphorus. The construction industry and those close to the government are pushing for work to start; environmental groups, water utilities and the opposition warn of the costs and the consequences for drinking water and the sea.
evi.kanal_istanbul.warum: Megaprojects tie up money, capital and attention for years. They promise growth; some deliver it, others leave mainly debt behind.
evi.kanal_istanbul.opt.bauen.label: Build it
evi.kanal_istanbul.opt.bauen.folge: contracts and headlines, plus debt and environmental risks.
evi.kanal_istanbul.opt.nahverkehr.label: Expand the metro and public transport instead
evi.kanal_istanbul.opt.nahverkehr.folge: noticeable in everyday life, less impressive in photos.
evi.kanal_istanbul.opt.nahverkehr.ausgan: The government opts for the metro and public transport instead of a canal.
evi.kanal_istanbul.opt.verschieben.label: Postpone
evi.kanal_istanbul.opt.verschieben.folge: the construction industry is disappointed, the money stays in the budget.
evi.kommunalwahl.text1: Mayors and municipal councils are being elected across the country. It is the first test of public mood since you took office; your approval stands at {zustimmung} %.
evi.kommunalwahl.warum: Local elections show whether people trust the President to run their city, and they are the dress rehearsal for the next presidential election.
evi.kommunalwahl.opt.reisen.label: Tour the country yourself
evi.kommunalwahl.opt.reisen.folge: brings votes and headlines, but mobilises opponents too.
evi.kommunalwahl.opt.projekte.label: Bring local projects forward
evi.kommunalwahl.opt.projekte.folge: roads and schools before election day.
evi.kommunalwahl.opt.projekte.ausgang: Projects in the provinces are brought forward. {ergebnis}
evi.kommunalwahl.opt.sachlich.label: Stay matter-of-fact
evi.kommunalwahl.opt.sachlich.ausgang: The President keeps a low profile in the campaign. {ergebnis}
